## MarkdownFeatureConfig.onBeforeWritePage() method

The [MarkdownFeatureConfig.onBeforeWritePage()](./api-documenter.markdownfeatureconfig.onbeforewritepage.md) method is called before each markdown file is written, providing an opportunity to customize the file content.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onBeforeWritePage?(this: void, page: MarkdownPage, item: ApiItem, context: MarkdownDocumenterFeatureContext): string;
```
